label: Museum Archive Drawer (Standard)
description: Climate-controlled, acid-free storage drawer designed to protect specimens from degradation. The true heart of any natural history museum.

components.function: Provides physical protection and light exclusion.
Cushions specimens and prevents chemical reactions.
Displays range of accession numbers, taxon, and stratigraphic level of contents.

game_mechanics.search_mini_game: Player must manually 'open' drawers and scan for relevant accession numbers or specimen types (e.g., 'all Theropod teeth from Hell Creek').
game_mechanics.condition_check: Some drawers might contain specimens suffering from 'pyrite disease' (a crumbling caused by unstable minerals) which the player can stabilize for a bonus.
